---- MODULE MultiShardTxnSnapshot ----
EXTENDS MultiShardTxnSnapshotDefs

\* BEGIN AGENT HELPERS
LOCAL MSSProof == INSTANCE TLAPS
LOCAL MSSSeq == INSTANCE SequenceTheorems
LOCAL MSSFinite == INSTANCE FiniteSetTheorems
LOCAL MSSNat == INSTANCE NaturalsInduction
LOCAL MSSFiniteExt == INSTANCE FiniteSetsExtTheorems

LEMMA MSSEmptyTransactions ==
    Init => SnapshotTransactions = {}
BY MSSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF Init, SnapshotTransactions

LEMMA MSSEmptyOrder ==
    <<>> \in SI!Orders({})
<1>1. SUBSET {} = {{}}
    BY MSSProof!SMTT("r10")
<1>2. DEFINE F == [ss \in SUBSET {} |-> {<<>>}]
<1>F. HIDE DEF F
<1>3. F = [ss \in SUBSET {} |->
               IF ss = {} THEN {<<>>}
               ELSE UNION {{Append(sq, x) : sq \in F[ss \ {x}]} : x \in ss}]
    BY <1>1, MSSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF F
<1>4. \E perms :
           perms = [ss \in SUBSET {} |->
                       IF ss = {} THEN {<<>>}
                       ELSE UNION {{Append(sq, x) : sq \in perms[ss \ {x}]} : x \in ss}]
    BY <1>3, MSSProof!Zenon
<1>5. DEFINE G == CHOOSE perms :
           perms = [ss \in SUBSET {} |->
                       IF ss = {} THEN {<<>>}
                       ELSE UNION {{Append(sq, x) : sq \in perms[ss \ {x}]} : x \in ss}]
<1>G. HIDE DEF G
<1>6. G = [ss \in SUBSET {} |->
               IF ss = {} THEN {<<>>}
               ELSE UNION {{Append(sq, x) : sq \in G[ss \ {x}]} : x \in ss}]
    BY <1>4, MSSProof!Zenon DEF G
<1>7. G[{}] = {<<>>}
    BY <1>1, <1>6, MSSProof!SMTT("r10")
<1>8. QED
    BY <1>7, MSSProof!Zenon DEF SI!Orders, SI!PermSeqs, G

LEMMA MSSFiniteBridge ==
    \A S : SI!IsFiniteSet(S) = MSSFinite!IsFiniteSet(S)
BY MSSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF SI!IsFiniteSet, MSSFinite!IsFiniteSet

LEMMA MSSInitialSnapshot ==
    Init => SnapshotIsolation
<1>1. Init => SI!WellFormed(InitialState, SnapshotTransactions)
    BY MSSEmptyTransactions, MSSFinite!FS_EmptySet, MSSFiniteBridge,
       MSSProof!SMTT("r10")
    DEF SI!WellFormed, InitialState
<1>2. SI!ExecutionSatisfiesSI(InitialState, <<>>)
    BY MSSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF SI!ExecutionSatisfiesSI
<1>3. QED
    BY <1>1, <1>2, MSSEmptyTransactions, MSSEmptyOrder,
       MSSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF SnapshotIsolation, SI!SnapshotIsolation
MSSSupport(f) == {t \in TxId : f[t] # <<>>}

MSSHist(f, h) ==
    /\ f \in [TxId -> Seq(SI!Operation)]
    /\ h \in [Shard -> [TxId -> Seq(SI!Operation)]]
    /\ MSSFinite!IsFiniteSet(MSSSupport(f))

MSSHistoryType == MSSHist(ops, shardOps)

MSSHistoryStep ==
    \/ UNCHANGED <<ops, shardOps>>
    \/ \E s \in Shard, t \in TxId, k \in Keys, v \in TxId \cup {NoValue} :
          /\ ops' = ops
          /\ shardOps' = [shardOps EXCEPT ![s][t] = shardOps[s][t] \o <<rOp(k,v)>>]
    \/ \E s \in Shard, t \in TxId, k \in Keys :
          /\ ops' = ops
          /\ shardOps' = [shardOps EXCEPT ![s][t] = Append(shardOps[s][t], wOp(k,t))]
    \/ \E s \in Shard, t \in TxId :
          /\ ops' = ops
          /\ shardOps' = [shardOps EXCEPT ![s][t] = <<>>]
    \/ \E s \in Shard, t \in TxId :
          /\ ops' = [ops EXCEPT ![t] = ops[t] \o shardOps[s][t]]
          /\ shardOps' = shardOps

LEMMA MSSOperationType ==
    \A k \in Keys, t \in TxId, v \in TxId \cup {NoValue} :
        /\ rOp(k,v) \in SI!Operation
        /\ wOp(k,t) \in SI!Operation
BY MSSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF rOp, wOp, CC!r, CC!w, SI!Operation

LEMMA MSSSupportUpdate ==
    \A f, sq : \A t \in TxId :
        f \in [TxId -> Seq(SI!Operation)] =>
          MSSSupport([f EXCEPT ![t] = sq]) \subseteq MSSSupport(f) \cup {t}
BY MSSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF MSSSupport

LEMMA MSSHistUpdateOps ==
    \A f, h : \A t \in TxId, sq \in Seq(SI!Operation) :
        MSSHist(f,h) => MSSHist([f EXCEPT ![t] = sq],h)
<1>1. ASSUME NEW f, NEW h, NEW t \in TxId, NEW sq \in Seq(SI!Operation),
             MSSHist(f,h)
      PROVE MSSHist([f EXCEPT ![t] = sq],h)
    <2>1. MSSFinite!IsFiniteSet(MSSSupport(f) \cup {t})
        BY <1>1, MSSFinite!FS_AddElement, MSSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF MSSHist
    <2>2. MSSFinite!IsFiniteSet(MSSSupport([f EXCEPT ![t] = sq]))
        BY <1>1, <2>1, MSSSupportUpdate, MSSFinite!FS_Subset, MSSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF MSSHist
    <2>3. QED
        BY <1>1, <2>2, MSSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF MSSHist
<1>2. QED BY <1>1, MSSProof!SMTT("r10")

LEMMA MSSHistUpdateShard ==
    \A f, h : \A s \in Shard, t \in TxId, sq \in Seq(SI!Operation) :
        MSSHist(f,h) => MSSHist(f,[h EXCEPT ![s][t] = sq])
BY MSSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF MSSHist

LEMMA MSSHistoryInit == Init => MSSHistoryType
<1>1. Init => MSSSupport(ops) = {}
    BY MSSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF Init, MSSSupport
<1>2. QED
    BY <1>1, MSSFinite!FS_EmptySet, MSSSeq!EmptySeq, MSSProof!SMTT("r10")
    DEF Init, MSSHistoryType, MSSHist

LEMMA MSSHistoryProjection == [Next]_vars => MSSHistoryStep
BY MSSProof!SMTT("r30")
   DEF Next, vars, MSSHistoryStep, RouterTxnStart, RouterTxnOp,
       RouterTxnCoordinateCommit, RouterTxnCommitReadOnly, RouterTxnCommitSingleShard,
       ShardTxnStart, ShardTxnRead, ShardTxnWrite, ShardTxnCoordinateCommit,
       ShardTxnCoordinatorRecvCommitVote, ShardTxnCoordinatorDecideCommit,
       ShardTxnPrepare, ShardTxnCommit, ShardTxnAbort

LEMMA MSSHistoryPreserved == MSSHistoryType /\ MSSHistoryStep => MSSHistoryType'
<1>0. SUFFICES ASSUME MSSHistoryType, MSSHistoryStep PROVE MSSHistoryType'
    BY MSSProof!SMTT("r10")
<1>1. \A s \in Shard, t \in TxId :
        MSSHistoryType => ops[t] \o shardOps[s][t] \in Seq(SI!Operation)
    BY MSSSeq!ConcatProperties, MSSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF MSSHistoryType, MSSHist
<1>2. \A s \in Shard, t \in TxId, k \in Keys, v \in TxId \cup {NoValue} :
        MSSHistoryType =>
          /\ shardOps[s][t] \o <<rOp(k,v)>> \in Seq(SI!Operation)
          /\ Append(shardOps[s][t],wOp(k,t)) \in Seq(SI!Operation)
    BY MSSOperationType, MSSSeq!ConcatProperties, MSSSeq!AppendProperties,
       MSSProof!SMTT("r30") DEF MSSHistoryType, MSSHist
<1>3. CASE UNCHANGED <<ops, shardOps>>
    BY <1>0, <1>3, MSSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF MSSHistoryType
<1>4. CASE \E s \in Shard, t \in TxId, k \in Keys, v \in TxId \cup {NoValue} :
          /\ ops' = ops
          /\ shardOps' = [shardOps EXCEPT ![s][t] = shardOps[s][t] \o <<rOp(k,v)>>]
    <2>1. PICK s \in Shard, t \in TxId, k \in Keys, v \in TxId \cup {NoValue} :
          /\ ops' = ops
          /\ shardOps' = [shardOps EXCEPT ![s][t] = shardOps[s][t] \o <<rOp(k,v)>>]
        BY <1>4, MSSProof!SMTT("r10")
    <2>2. shardOps[s][t] \o <<rOp(k,v)>> \in Seq(SI!Operation)
        BY <1>0, <1>2, <2>1, MSSProof!SMTT("r10")
    <2>3. QED
        BY <1>0, <2>1, <2>2, MSSHistUpdateShard, MSSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF MSSHistoryType
<1>5. CASE \E s \in Shard, t \in TxId, k \in Keys :
          /\ ops' = ops
          /\ shardOps' = [shardOps EXCEPT ![s][t] = Append(shardOps[s][t], wOp(k,t))]
    <2>1. PICK s \in Shard, t \in TxId, k \in Keys :
          /\ ops' = ops
          /\ shardOps' = [shardOps EXCEPT ![s][t] = Append(shardOps[s][t], wOp(k,t))]
        BY <1>5, MSSProof!SMTT("r10")
    <2>2. Append(shardOps[s][t],wOp(k,t)) \in Seq(SI!Operation)
        BY <1>0, <1>2, <2>1, MSSProof!SMTT("r10")
    <2>3. QED
        BY <1>0, <2>1, <2>2, MSSHistUpdateShard, MSSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF MSSHistoryType
<1>6. CASE \E s \in Shard, t \in TxId :
          /\ ops' = ops
          /\ shardOps' = [shardOps EXCEPT ![s][t] = <<>>]
    <2>1. PICK s \in Shard, t \in TxId :
          /\ ops' = ops
          /\ shardOps' = [shardOps EXCEPT ![s][t] = <<>>]
        BY <1>6, MSSProof!SMTT("r10")
    <2>2. <<>> \in Seq(SI!Operation)
        BY MSSSeq!EmptySeq, MSSProof!SMTT("r10")
    <2>3. QED
        BY <1>0, <2>1, <2>2, MSSHistUpdateShard, MSSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF MSSHistoryType
<1>7. CASE \E s \in Shard, t \in TxId :
          /\ ops' = [ops EXCEPT ![t] = ops[t] \o shardOps[s][t]]
          /\ shardOps' = shardOps
    <2>1. PICK s \in Shard, t \in TxId :
          /\ ops' = [ops EXCEPT ![t] = ops[t] \o shardOps[s][t]]
          /\ shardOps' = shardOps
        BY <1>7, MSSProof!SMTT("r10")
    <2>2. ops[t] \o shardOps[s][t] \in Seq(SI!Operation)
        BY <1>0, <1>1, <2>1, MSSProof!SMTT("r10")
    <2>3. QED
        BY <1>0, <2>1, <2>2, MSSHistUpdateOps, MSSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF MSSHistoryType
<1>8. QED
    BY <1>0, <1>3, <1>4, <1>5, <1>6, <1>7, MSSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF MSSHistoryStep

LEMMA MSSHistoryAlways == Spec => []MSSHistoryType
<1>1. Init => MSSHistoryType BY MSSHistoryInit, MSSProof!SMTT("r10")
<1>2. MSSHistoryType /\ [Next]_vars => MSSHistoryType'
    BY MSSHistoryProjection, MSSHistoryPreserved, MSSProof!SMTT("r10")
<1>3. QED BY <1>1, <1>2, MSSProof!PTL DEF Spec

LEMMA MSSHistoryWellFormed ==
    MSSHistoryType => SI!WellFormed(InitialState,SnapshotTransactions)
<1>1. MSSHistoryType =>
        SnapshotTransactions = {[id |-> t, ops |-> ops[t]] : t \in MSSSupport(ops)}
    BY MSSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF MSSHistoryType, MSSHist, MSSSupport, SnapshotTransactions
<1>2. MSSHistoryType => MSSFinite!IsFiniteSet(SnapshotTransactions)
    BY <1>1, MSSFinite!FS_Image, MSSProof!Isa DEF MSSHistoryType, MSSHist
<1>3. QED
    BY <1>2, MSSFiniteBridge, MSSProof!SMTT("r10")
    DEF MSSHistoryType, MSSHist, SI!WellFormed, SnapshotTransactions, InitialState
MSSApplyOperation(state, operation) ==
    IF operation.op = "write"
    THEN [state EXCEPT ![operation.key] = operation.value]
    ELSE state

MSSWritesOwned(operationSequence, t) ==
    \A i \in 1..Len(operationSequence) :
        operationSequence[i].op = "write" => operationSequence[i].value = t

MSSWritten(operationSequence, i) ==
    {operationSequence[j].key :
        j \in {h \in 1..i : operationSequence[h].op = "write"}}

MSSOwnView(snapshot, t, operationSequence, i) ==
    [k \in Keys |-> IF k \in MSSWritten(operationSequence,i) THEN t ELSE snapshot[k]]

LEMMA MSSOperationRecursion ==
    ASSUME NEW initial, NEW operationSequence \in Seq(SI!Operation)
    PROVE SI!OperationStates(initial,operationSequence) =
        [i \in 0..Len(operationSequence) |->
            IF i = 0 THEN initial
            ELSE MSSApplyOperation(SI!OperationStates(initial,operationSequence)[i-1],
                                   operationSequence[i])]
<1>1. DEFINE Step(state, i) == MSSApplyOperation(state,operationSequence[i])
<1>S. HIDE DEF Step
<1>2. MSSNat!FiniteNatInductiveDefHypothesis(
          SI!OperationStates(initial,operationSequence), initial, Step, 0, Len(operationSequence))
    BY MSSProof!Zenon
    DEF MSSNat!FiniteNatInductiveDefHypothesis, SI!OperationStates, Step, MSSApplyOperation
<1>3. Len(operationSequence) \in Nat
    BY MSSSeq!LenProperties, MSSProof!SMTT("r10")
<1>4. MSSNat!FiniteNatInductiveDefConclusion(
          SI!OperationStates(initial,operationSequence), initial, Step, 0, Len(operationSequence))
    BY <1>2, <1>3, MSSNat!FiniteNatInductiveDef, MSSProof!Isa
<1>5. QED
    BY <1>4, MSSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF MSSNat!FiniteNatInductiveDefConclusion, Step

LEMMA MSSWrittenStep ==
    \A operationSequence \in Seq(SI!Operation) :
      \A i \in 0..(Len(operationSequence)-1) :
        MSSWritten(operationSequence,i+1) =
          IF operationSequence[i+1].op = "write"
          THEN MSSWritten(operationSequence,i) \cup {operationSequence[i+1].key}
          ELSE MSSWritten(operationSequence,i)
BY MSSSeq!LenProperties, MSSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF MSSWritten

LEMMA MSSOwnViewStep ==
    ASSUME NEW snapshot \in [Keys -> TxId \cup {NoValue}],
           NEW t \in TxId,
           NEW operationSequence \in Seq(SI!Operation),
           MSSWritesOwned(operationSequence,t),
           NEW i \in 0..(Len(operationSequence)-1)
    PROVE MSSOwnView(snapshot,t,operationSequence,i+1) =
          MSSApplyOperation(MSSOwnView(snapshot,t,operationSequence,i),operationSequence[i+1])
BY MSSWrittenStep, MSSSeq!LenProperties, MSSSeq!ElementOfSeq, MSSProof!SMTT("r30")
   DEF MSSOwnView, MSSApplyOperation, MSSWritesOwned, SI!Operation

LEMMA MSSOwnOperationState ==
    ASSUME NEW snapshot \in [Keys -> TxId \cup {NoValue}],
           NEW t \in TxId,
           NEW operationSequence \in Seq(SI!Operation),
           MSSWritesOwned(operationSequence,t)
    PROVE \A i \in 0..Len(operationSequence) :
        SI!OperationStates(snapshot,operationSequence)[i] = MSSOwnView(snapshot,t,operationSequence,i)
<1>1. DEFINE P(i) == i \in 0..Len(operationSequence) =>
        SI!OperationStates(snapshot,operationSequence)[i] = MSSOwnView(snapshot,t,operationSequence,i)
<1>P. HIDE DEF P
<1>2. P(0)
    BY MSSOperationRecursion, MSSSeq!LenProperties, MSSProof!SMTT("r10")
    DEF P, MSSOwnView, MSSWritten
<1>3. \A i \in Nat : P(i) => P(i+1)
    BY MSSOwnViewStep, MSSOperationRecursion, MSSSeq!LenProperties, MSSProof!SMTT("r30") DEF P
<1>4. \A i \in Nat : P(i)
    BY <1>2, <1>3, MSSNat!NatInduction, MSSProof!Isa
<1>5. QED
    BY <1>4, MSSSeq!LenProperties, MSSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF P

LEMMA MSSOwnEffects ==
    ASSUME NEW snapshot \in [Keys -> TxId \cup {NoValue}],
           NEW t \in TxId,
           NEW operationSequence \in Seq(SI!Operation),
           MSSWritesOwned(operationSequence,t)
    PROVE SI!Effects(snapshot,operationSequence) =
          MSSOwnView(snapshot,t,operationSequence,Len(operationSequence))
BY MSSOwnOperationState, MSSSeq!LenProperties, MSSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF SI!Effects

LEMMA MSSOwnComplete ==
    ASSUME NEW snapshot \in [Keys -> TxId \cup {NoValue}],
           NEW t \in TxId,
           NEW operationSequence \in Seq(SI!Operation),
           MSSWritesOwned(operationSequence,t)
    PROVE SI!Complete(snapshot,operationSequence) <=>
          \A i \in 1..Len(operationSequence) :
            operationSequence[i].op = "read" =>
              operationSequence[i].value =
                IF operationSequence[i].key \in MSSWritten(operationSequence,i-1)
                THEN t ELSE snapshot[operationSequence[i].key]
BY MSSOwnOperationState, MSSSeq!LenProperties, MSSSeq!ElementOfSeq, MSSProof!SMTT("r30")
   DEF SI!Complete, MSSOwnView, SI!Operation

MSSReadTime(t) ==
    CHOOSE ts \in Timestamps :
        \E s \in Shard : /\ "ts" \in DOMAIN txnSnapshots[s][t]
                         /\ txnSnapshots[s][t].ts = ts

MSSWriteEntries(t) ==
    UNION {{e \in Range(log[s]) : /\ "data" \in DOMAIN e
                                 /\ e.tid = t
                                 /\ DOMAIN e.data # {}} : s \in Shard}

MSSCommitTime(t) ==
    IF MSSWriteEntries(t) = {} THEN MSSReadTime(t)+1
    ELSE max({e.ts : e \in MSSWriteEntries(t)})

MSSKeyWrites(t) == SI!WriteKeys(ops[t])

MSSVisibleWriters(k, ts) ==
    {t \in MSSSupport(ops) : k \in MSSKeyWrites(t) /\ MSSCommitTime(t) <= ts}

MSSReadMatches(t, i) ==
    LET k == ops[t][i].key
        visible == MSSVisibleWriters(k,MSSReadTime(t))
    IN IF k \in MSSWritten(ops[t],i-1) THEN ops[t][i].value = t
       ELSE IF visible = {} THEN ops[t][i].value = NoValue
       ELSE /\ ops[t][i].value \in visible
            /\ \A u \in visible : MSSCommitTime(u) <= MSSCommitTime(ops[t][i].value)

MSSSnapshotCertificate ==
    /\ \A t \in MSSSupport(ops) :
         /\ MSSReadTime(t) \in Nat
         /\ MSSCommitTime(t) \in Nat
         /\ MSSCommitTime(t) > MSSReadTime(t)
         /\ \A e \in MSSWriteEntries(t) : e.ts = MSSCommitTime(t)
         /\ MSSWritesOwned(ops[t],t)
         /\ \A i \in 1..Len(ops[t]) : ops[t][i].op = "read" => MSSReadMatches(t,i)
    /\ \A t,u \in MSSSupport(ops) :
         t # u /\ MSSKeyWrites(t) \cap MSSKeyWrites(u) # {} =>
           \/ MSSCommitTime(t) <= MSSReadTime(u)
           \/ MSSCommitTime(u) <= MSSReadTime(t)

LEMMA MSSCertificateInit == Init => MSSSnapshotCertificate
<1>1. Init => MSSSupport(ops) = {}
    BY MSSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF Init, MSSSupport
<1>2. QED
    BY <1>1, MSSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF MSSSnapshotCertificate

MSSPermutationStep(p, S) ==
    IF S = {} THEN {<<>>}
    ELSE UNION {{Append(q,x) : q \in p[S \ {x}]} : x \in S}

MSSPermutations(S) ==
    CHOOSE p : p = [T \in SUBSET S |-> MSSPermutationStep(p,T)]

LEMMA MSSPermutationRecursion ==
    ASSUME NEW S, MSSFinite!IsFiniteSet(S)
    PROVE MSSPermutations(S) =
          [T \in SUBSET S |-> MSSPermutationStep(MSSPermutations(S),T)]
<1>1. MSSFinite!IsWellFoundedOn(MSSFinite!StrictSubsetOrdering(S), SUBSET S)
    BY MSSFinite!FS_StrictSubsetOrderingWellFounded, MSSFinite!FS_FiniteSubsetsOfFinite,
       MSSProof!SMTT("r10")
<1>2. MSSFinite!WFDefOn(MSSFinite!StrictSubsetOrdering(S), SUBSET S, MSSPermutationStep)
    BY MSSProof!SMTT("r30")
    DEF MSSFinite!WFDefOn, MSSFinite!SetLessThan, MSSFinite!StrictSubsetOrdering,
        MSSPermutationStep
<1>3. MSSFinite!OpDefinesFcn(MSSPermutations(S), SUBSET S, MSSPermutationStep)
    BY MSSProof!Zenon DEF MSSFinite!OpDefinesFcn, MSSPermutations
<1>4. MSSFinite!WFInductiveDefines(MSSPermutations(S), SUBSET S, MSSPermutationStep)
    BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, MSSFinite!WFInductiveDef, MSSProof!Isa
<1>5. QED
    BY <1>4, MSSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF MSSFinite!WFInductiveDefines

LEMMA MSSPermutationOrders ==
    \A S : SI!Orders(S) = MSSPermutations(S)[S]
BY MSSProof!Zenon DEF SI!Orders, SI!PermSeqs, MSSPermutations, MSSPermutationStep

LEMMA MSSRankMaximum ==
    ASSUME NEW S, MSSFinite!IsFiniteSet(S), S # {}, NEW rank,
           \A x \in S : rank[x] \in Nat
    PROVE \E x \in S : \A y \in S : rank[y] <= rank[x]
<1>1. MSSFinite!IsFiniteSet({rank[x] : x \in S})
    BY MSSFinite!FS_Image, MSSProof!Isa
<1>2. MSSFiniteExt!IsFiniteSet({rank[x] : x \in S})
    BY <1>1, MSSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF MSSFiniteExt!IsFiniteSet, MSSFinite!IsFiniteSet
<1>3. {rank[x] : x \in S} \subseteq Int /\ {rank[x] : x \in S} # {}
    BY MSSProof!SMTT("r10")
<1>4. MSSFiniteExt!Max({rank[x] : x \in S}) \in {rank[x] : x \in S}
       /\ \A n \in {rank[x] : x \in S} : n <= MSSFiniteExt!Max({rank[x] : x \in S})
    BY <1>2, <1>3, MSSFiniteExt!MaxIntFinite, MSSProof!SMTT("r10")
<1>5. QED BY <1>4, MSSProof!SMTT("r10")

MSSSorted(q, S, rank) ==
    /\ q \in Seq(S)
    /\ Range(q) = S
    /\ \A i,j \in 1..Len(q) :
         i < j => q[i] # q[j] /\ rank[q[i]] <= rank[q[j]]

LEMMA MSSRangeBridge == \A f : MSSSeq!Range(f) = Range(f)
BY MSSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF MSSSeq!Range, Range

LEMMA MSSSortedAppend ==
    ASSUME NEW S, NEW x \in S, NEW rank, NEW q,
           MSSSorted(q,S \ {x},rank),
           \A y \in S : rank[y] \in Nat /\ rank[y] <= rank[x]
    PROVE MSSSorted(Append(q,x),S,rank)
<1>1. q \in Seq(S)
    BY MSSSeq!SeqMonotonic, MSSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF MSSSorted
<1>A. /\ Append(q,x) \in Seq(S)
      /\ Len(Append(q,x)) = Len(q)+1
      /\ MSSSeq!Range(Append(q,x)) = MSSSeq!Range(q) \cup {x}
      /\ (\A i \in 1..Len(q) : Append(q,x)[i] = q[i])
      /\ Append(q,x)[Len(q)+1] = x
    <2>1. Append(q,x) \in Seq(S)
        BY <1>1, MSSSeq!AppendProperties, MSSProof!SMTT("r10")
    <2>2. Len(Append(q,x)) = Len(q)+1
        BY <1>1, MSSSeq!AppendProperties, MSSProof!SMTT("r10")
    <2>3. MSSSeq!Range(Append(q,x)) = MSSSeq!Range(q) \cup {x}
        BY <1>1, MSSSeq!AppendProperties, MSSProof!SMTT("r10")
    <2>4. \A i \in 1..Len(q) : Append(q,x)[i] = q[i]
        BY <1>1, MSSSeq!AppendProperties, MSSProof!SMTT("r10")
    <2>5. Append(q,x)[Len(q)+1] = x
        BY <1>1, MSSSeq!AppendProperties, MSSProof!SMTT("r10")
    <2>6. QED BY <2>1, <2>2, <2>3, <2>4, <2>5, MSSProof!SMTT("r10")
<1>B. Range(Append(q,x)) = Range(q) \cup {x}
    BY ONLY <1>A, MSSRangeBridge, MSSProof!Zenon
<1>C. Range(q) = S \ {x}
    BY MSSProof!SMTT("r3") DEF MSSSorted
<1>D. Range(q) \cup {x} = S
    BY ONLY <1>C, x \in S, MSSProof!SMTT("r3")
<1>2. /\ Append(q,x) \in Seq(S)
      /\ Len(Append(q,x)) = Len(q)+1
      /\ Range(Append(q,x)) = S
      /\ (\A i \in 1..Len(q) : Append(q,x)[i] = q[i])
      /\ Append(q,x)[Len(q)+1] = x
    BY ONLY <1>A, <1>B, <1>D, MSSProof!SMTT("r3")
<1>3. \A i \in 1..Len(q) : q[i] \in S \ {x}
    BY MSSSeq!ElementOfSeq, MSSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF MSSSorted
<1>4. QED
    BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, MSSSeq!LenProperties, MSSProof!SMTT("r30") DEF MSSSorted

LEMMA MSSSortedOrderExists ==
    ASSUME NEW S, MSSFinite!IsFiniteSet(S), NEW rank,
           \A x \in S : rank[x] \in Nat
    PROVE \E q \in SI!Orders(S) : MSSSorted(q,S,rank)
<1>1. DEFINE P(T) == \E q \in MSSPermutations(S)[T] : MSSSorted(q,T,rank)
<1>P. HIDE DEF P
<1>2. ASSUME NEW T \in SUBSET S,
             \A U \in (SUBSET T) \ {T} : P(U)
      PROVE P(T)
    <2>1. MSSPermutations(S)[T] = MSSPermutationStep(MSSPermutations(S),T)
        BY <1>2, MSSPermutationRecursion, MSSProof!SMTT("r10")
    <2>2. CASE T = {}
        BY <1>2, <2>1, <2>2, MSSSeq!EmptySeq, MSSProof!SMTT("r10")
        DEF P, MSSPermutationStep, MSSSorted, Range
    <2>3. CASE T # {}
        <3>1. MSSFinite!IsFiniteSet(T) /\ \A x \in T : rank[x] \in Nat
            BY <1>2, MSSFinite!FS_Subset, MSSProof!SMTT("r10")
        <3>2. PICK x \in T : \A y \in T : rank[y] <= rank[x]
            BY <2>3, <3>1, MSSRankMaximum, MSSProof!SMTT("r10")
        <3>3. P(T \ {x})
            BY <1>2, <3>2, MSSProof!SMTT("r10")
        <3>4. PICK q \in MSSPermutations(S)[T \ {x}] : MSSSorted(q,T \ {x},rank)
            BY <3>3, MSSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF P
        <3>5. MSSSorted(Append(q,x),T,rank)
            BY <3>1, <3>2, <3>4, MSSSortedAppend, MSSProof!SMTT("r10")
        <3>6. Append(q,x) \in MSSPermutations(S)[T]
            BY <2>1, <2>3, <3>2, <3>4, MSSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF MSSPermutationStep
        <3>7. QED
            BY <3>5, <3>6, MSSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF P
    <2>4. QED BY <2>2, <2>3, MSSProof!SMTT("r10")
<1>3. P(S)
    BY ONLY MSSFinite!IsFiniteSet(S), <1>2, MSSFinite!FS_WFInduction, MSSProof!IsaM("blast")
<1>4. QED
    BY <1>3, MSSPermutationOrders, MSSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF P

LEMMA MSSSortedCut ==
    ASSUME NEW S, NEW q, NEW rank, MSSSorted(q,S,rank),
           \A x \in S : rank[x] \in Nat,
           NEW j \in 1..Len(q), NEW ts \in Nat, ts < rank[q[j]]
    PROVE \E cut \in 0..(j-1) :
        \A i \in 1..Len(q) : (i <= cut) <=> (rank[q[i]] <= ts)
<1>1. DEFINE P(n) == n \in 1..Len(q) /\ ts < rank[q[n]]
<1>P. HIDE DEF P
<1>2. P(j) /\ j \in Nat
    BY MSSSeq!LenProperties, MSSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF P, MSSSorted
<1>3. \E m \in Nat : P(m) /\ \A k \in 0..(m-1) : ~P(k)
    BY <1>2, MSSNat!SmallestNatural, MSSProof!Isa
<1>4. PICK m \in Nat : P(m) /\ \A k \in 0..(m-1) : ~P(k)
    BY <1>3, MSSProof!SMTT("r10")
<1>5. m \in 1..j /\ m-1 \in 0..(j-1)
    BY <1>2, <1>4, MSSSeq!LenProperties, MSSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF P, MSSSorted
<1>6. \A i \in 1..Len(q) : (i <= m-1) <=> (rank[q[i]] <= ts)
    <2>1. ASSUME NEW i \in 1..Len(q) PROVE (i <= m-1) <=> (rank[q[i]] <= ts)
        <3>1. i \in Nat /\ rank[q[i]] \in Nat /\ rank[q[m]] \in Nat /\ Len(q) \in Nat
            BY <1>4, <2>1, MSSSeq!LenProperties, MSSSeq!ElementOfSeq, MSSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF P, MSSSorted
        <3>2. CASE i < m
            BY <1>4, <1>5, <2>1, <3>1, <3>2, MSSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF P
        <3>3. CASE i = m
            BY <1>4, <2>1, <3>1, <3>3, MSSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF P
        <3>4. CASE i > m
            <4>1. rank[q[m]] <= rank[q[i]] /\ ts < rank[q[m]]
                BY <1>4, <2>1, <3>4, MSSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF P, MSSSorted
            <4>2. QED
                BY <1>4, <3>1, <3>4, <4>1, MSSProof!SMTT("r10")
        <3>5. QED BY <1>4, <3>1, <3>2, <3>3, <3>4, MSSProof!SMTT("r10")
    <2>2. QED BY <2>1, MSSProof!SMTT("r10")
<1>7. QED BY <1>5, <1>6, MSSProof!SMTT("r10")

LEMMA MSSWrittenKeys ==
    \A operationSequence : MSSWritten(operationSequence,Len(operationSequence)) =
                            SI!WriteKeys(operationSequence)
BY MSSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF MSSWritten, SI!WriteKeys

MSSOrderElements == [id : TxId, ops : Seq(SI!Operation)]

MSSOrderOwnWrites(q) ==
    \A j \in 1..Len(q) : MSSWritesOwned(q[j].ops,q[j].id)

MSSPrefixState(q, states, j) ==
    /\ states[j] \in [Keys -> TxId \cup {NoValue}]
    /\ \A k \in Keys :
         /\ (\A i \in 1..j : k \notin SI!WriteKeys(q[i].ops)) => states[j][k] = NoValue
         /\ \A i \in 1..j :
              (/\ k \in SI!WriteKeys(q[i].ops)
               /\ \A h \in (i+1)..j : k \notin SI!WriteKeys(q[h].ops)) =>
                states[j][k] = q[i].id

LEMMA MSSExecutionRecursion ==
    ASSUME NEW q \in Seq(MSSOrderElements)
    PROVE SI!ExecutionStates(InitialState,q) =
        [j \in 0..Len(q) |-> IF j = 0 THEN InitialState
          ELSE SI!Effects(SI!ExecutionStates(InitialState,q)[j-1],q[j].ops)]
<1>1. DEFINE Step(state, j) == SI!Effects(state,q[j].ops)
<1>S. HIDE DEF Step
<1>2. MSSNat!FiniteNatInductiveDefHypothesis(
          SI!ExecutionStates(InitialState,q), InitialState, Step, 0, Len(q))
    BY MSSProof!Zenon DEF MSSNat!FiniteNatInductiveDefHypothesis, SI!ExecutionStates, Step
<1>3. Len(q) \in Nat
    BY MSSSeq!LenProperties, MSSProof!SMTT("r10")
<1>4. MSSNat!FiniteNatInductiveDefConclusion(
          SI!ExecutionStates(InitialState,q), InitialState, Step, 0, Len(q))
    BY <1>2, <1>3, MSSNat!FiniteNatInductiveDef, MSSProof!Isa
<1>5. QED
    BY <1>4, MSSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF MSSNat!FiniteNatInductiveDefConclusion, Step

LEMMA MSSPrefixStep ==
    ASSUME NEW q \in Seq(MSSOrderElements), MSSOrderOwnWrites(q),
           NEW states, NEW j \in 0..(Len(q)-1), MSSPrefixState(q,states,j),
           states[j+1] = SI!Effects(states[j],q[j+1].ops)
    PROVE MSSPrefixState(q,states,j+1)
<1>1. /\ q[j+1].ops \in Seq(SI!Operation)
       /\ q[j+1].id \in TxId
       /\ MSSWritesOwned(q[j+1].ops,q[j+1].id)
       /\ states[j] \in [Keys -> TxId \cup {NoValue}]
    BY MSSSeq!LenProperties, MSSSeq!ElementOfSeq, MSSProof!SMTT("r10")
    DEF MSSOrderElements, MSSOrderOwnWrites, MSSPrefixState
<1>2. states[j+1] = [k \in Keys |->
          IF k \in SI!WriteKeys(q[j+1].ops) THEN q[j+1].id ELSE states[j][k]]
    BY <1>1, MSSOwnEffects, MSSWrittenKeys, MSSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF MSSOwnView
<1>3. QED
    BY <1>1, <1>2, MSSSeq!LenProperties, MSSProof!SMTT("r30") DEF MSSPrefixState

LEMMA MSSExecutionPrefix ==
    ASSUME NEW q \in Seq(MSSOrderElements), MSSOrderOwnWrites(q)
    PROVE \A j \in 0..Len(q) : MSSPrefixState(q,SI!ExecutionStates(InitialState,q),j)
<1>1. DEFINE P(j) == j \in 0..Len(q) => MSSPrefixState(q,SI!ExecutionStates(InitialState,q),j)
<1>P. HIDE DEF P
<1>2. P(0)
    BY MSSExecutionRecursion, MSSSeq!LenProperties, MSSProof!SMTT("r10")
    DEF P, MSSPrefixState, InitialState
<1>3. \A j \in Nat : P(j) => P(j+1)
    BY MSSExecutionRecursion, MSSPrefixStep, MSSSeq!LenProperties, MSSProof!SMTT("r30") DEF P
<1>4. \A j \in Nat : P(j)
    BY <1>2, <1>3, MSSNat!NatInduction, MSSProof!Isa
<1>5. QED
    BY <1>4, MSSSeq!LenProperties, MSSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF P

MSSOrderRanks == [t \in SnapshotTransactions |-> MSSCommitTime(t.id)]

MSSOrderFacts(q) ==
    /\ q \in Seq(MSSOrderElements)
    /\ MSSOrderOwnWrites(q)
    /\ Range(q) = SnapshotTransactions
    /\ \A i \in 1..Len(q) :
         /\ q[i].id \in MSSSupport(ops)
         /\ q[i].ops = ops[q[i].id]
         /\ MSSCommitTime(q[i].id) \in Nat
         /\ MSSReadTime(q[i].id) \in Nat
         /\ MSSReadTime(q[i].id) < MSSCommitTime(q[i].id)
    /\ \A i,j \in 1..Len(q) : i < j =>
         /\ q[i].id # q[j].id
         /\ MSSCommitTime(q[i].id) <= MSSCommitTime(q[j].id)

LEMMA MSSSnapshotMembers == MSSHistoryType =>
    /\ SnapshotTransactions \subseteq MSSOrderElements
    /\ (\A t \in SnapshotTransactions :
          t.id \in MSSSupport(ops) /\ t.ops = ops[t.id])
    /\ \A t \in MSSSupport(ops) : [id |-> t, ops |-> ops[t]] \in SnapshotTransactions
BY MSSProof!SMTT("r10")
   DEF MSSHistoryType, MSSHist, MSSOrderElements, SnapshotTransactions, MSSSupport

LEMMA MSSOrderedFacts ==
    ASSUME MSSHistoryType, MSSSnapshotCertificate, NEW q,
           MSSSorted(q,SnapshotTransactions,MSSOrderRanks)
    PROVE MSSOrderFacts(q)
<1>1. q \in Seq(MSSOrderElements) /\ Range(q) = SnapshotTransactions
    BY MSSSnapshotMembers, MSSSeq!SeqMonotonic, MSSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF MSSSorted
<1>2. \A i \in 1..Len(q) : q[i] \in SnapshotTransactions
    BY MSSSeq!ElementOfSeq, MSSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF MSSSorted
<1>3. QED
    BY <1>1, <1>2, MSSSnapshotMembers, MSSHistoryWellFormed, MSSProof!SMTT("r30")
    DEF MSSOrderFacts, MSSOrderOwnWrites, MSSSorted, MSSOrderRanks,
        MSSSnapshotCertificate, SI!WellFormed

LEMMA MSSCertificateNoConflict ==
    ASSUME MSSSnapshotCertificate, NEW q, MSSOrderFacts(q),
           NEW j \in 1..Len(q), NEW cut \in 0..(j-1),
           \A i \in 1..Len(q) : (i <= cut) <=>
             (MSSCommitTime(q[i].id) <= MSSReadTime(q[j].id))
    PROVE SI!NoConf(q,j,cut)
<1>1. ASSUME NEW i \in (cut+1)..(j-1)
      PROVE SI!WriteKeys(q[i].ops) \cap SI!WriteKeys(q[j].ops) = {}
    <2>1. /\ i \in 1..Len(q)
          /\ MSSCommitTime(q[i].id) <= MSSCommitTime(q[j].id)
          /\ MSSCommitTime(q[i].id) > MSSReadTime(q[j].id)
          /\ MSSReadTime(q[i].id) < MSSCommitTime(q[i].id)
          /\ q[i].id # q[j].id
        BY <1>1, MSSSeq!LenProperties, MSSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF MSSOrderFacts
    <2>2. QED
        BY <1>1, <2>1, MSSProof!SMTT("r10")
        DEF MSSSnapshotCertificate, MSSOrderFacts, MSSKeyWrites
<1>2. QED BY <1>1, MSSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF SI!NoConf

LEMMA MSSVisiblePrefixValue ==
    ASSUME MSSHistoryType, MSSSnapshotCertificate, NEW q, MSSOrderFacts(q),
           NEW cut \in 0..Len(q), NEW ts \in Nat,
           \A i \in 1..Len(q) : (i <= cut) <=> (MSSCommitTime(q[i].id) <= ts),
           NEW k \in Keys, NEW v,
           \/ /\ MSSVisibleWriters(k,ts) = {} /\ v = NoValue
           \/ /\ v \in MSSVisibleWriters(k,ts)
              /\ \A u \in MSSVisibleWriters(k,ts) : MSSCommitTime(u) <= MSSCommitTime(v)
    PROVE SI!ExecutionStates(InitialState,q)[cut][k] = v
<1>1. MSSPrefixState(q,SI!ExecutionStates(InitialState,q),cut)
    BY MSSExecutionPrefix, MSSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF MSSOrderFacts
<1>2. CASE MSSVisibleWriters(k,ts) = {}
    <2>1. \A i \in 1..cut : k \notin SI!WriteKeys(q[i].ops)
        BY <1>2, MSSSeq!LenProperties, MSSProof!SMTT("r10")
        DEF MSSOrderFacts, MSSVisibleWriters, MSSKeyWrites
    <2>2. QED
        BY <1>1, <1>2, <2>1, MSSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF MSSPrefixState
<1>3. CASE MSSVisibleWriters(k,ts) # {}
    <2>1. /\ v \in MSSVisibleWriters(k,ts)
          /\ \A u \in MSSVisibleWriters(k,ts) : MSSCommitTime(u) <= MSSCommitTime(v)
        BY <1>3, MSSProof!SMTT("r10")
    <2>2. PICK h \in 1..Len(q) : q[h] = [id |-> v, ops |-> ops[v]]
        BY <2>1, MSSSnapshotMembers, MSSSeq!LenProperties, MSSProof!SMTT("r10")
        DEF MSSOrderFacts, MSSVisibleWriters, Range
    <2>3. h \in 1..cut /\ k \in SI!WriteKeys(q[h].ops)
        BY <2>1, <2>2, MSSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF MSSVisibleWriters, MSSKeyWrites
    <2>4. \A i \in (h+1)..cut : k \notin SI!WriteKeys(q[i].ops)
        <3>1. ASSUME NEW i \in (h+1)..cut, k \in SI!WriteKeys(q[i].ops) PROVE FALSE
            <4>1. /\ i \in 1..Len(q)
                  /\ q[i].id \in MSSVisibleWriters(k,ts)
                  /\ MSSCommitTime(v) <= MSSCommitTime(q[i].id)
                  /\ q[i].id # v
                BY <2>2, <2>3, <3>1, MSSSeq!LenProperties, MSSProof!SMTT("r10")
                DEF MSSOrderFacts, MSSVisibleWriters, MSSKeyWrites
            <4>2. MSSCommitTime(q[i].id) = MSSCommitTime(v)
                BY <2>1, <2>2, <4>1, MSSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF MSSOrderFacts
            <4>3. QED
                BY <2>1, <2>2, <2>3, <3>1, <4>1, <4>2, MSSProof!SMTT("r10")
                DEF MSSSnapshotCertificate, MSSVisibleWriters, MSSKeyWrites, MSSOrderFacts
        <3>2. QED BY <3>1, MSSProof!SMTT("r10")
    <2>5. QED
        BY <1>1, <2>2, <2>3, <2>4, MSSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF MSSPrefixState
<1>4. QED BY <1>2, <1>3, MSSProof!SMTT("r10")

LEMMA MSSCertificateComplete ==
    ASSUME MSSHistoryType, MSSSnapshotCertificate, NEW q, MSSOrderFacts(q),
           NEW j \in 1..Len(q), NEW cut \in 0..(j-1),
           \A i \in 1..Len(q) : (i <= cut) <=>
             (MSSCommitTime(q[i].id) <= MSSReadTime(q[j].id))
    PROVE SI!Complete(SI!ExecutionStates(InitialState,q)[cut],q[j].ops)
<1>1. /\ cut \in 0..Len(q)
       /\ q[j].id \in TxId
       /\ q[j].ops \in Seq(SI!Operation)
       /\ MSSWritesOwned(q[j].ops,q[j].id)
       /\ MSSReadTime(q[j].id) \in Nat
    BY MSSSeq!LenProperties, MSSSeq!ElementOfSeq, MSSProof!SMTT("r10")
    DEF MSSOrderFacts, MSSOrderOwnWrites, MSSOrderElements
<1>2. SI!ExecutionStates(InitialState,q)[cut] \in [Keys -> TxId \cup {NoValue}]
    BY <1>1, MSSExecutionPrefix, MSSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF MSSOrderFacts, MSSPrefixState
<1>F. q[j].ops = ops[q[j].id]
    BY MSSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF MSSOrderFacts
<1>3. ASSUME NEW i \in 1..Len(q[j].ops), q[j].ops[i].op = "read"
      PROVE q[j].ops[i].value =
        IF q[j].ops[i].key \in MSSWritten(q[j].ops,i-1)
        THEN q[j].id ELSE SI!ExecutionStates(InitialState,q)[cut][q[j].ops[i].key]
    <2>1. q[j].ops[i].key \in Keys /\ MSSReadMatches(q[j].id,i)
        BY <1>1, <1>3, MSSSeq!ElementOfSeq, MSSProof!SMTT("r10")
        DEF MSSOrderFacts, MSSSnapshotCertificate, SI!Operation
    <2>2. CASE q[j].ops[i].key \in MSSWritten(q[j].ops,i-1)
        BY <1>F, <1>3, <2>1, <2>2, MSSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF MSSReadMatches
    <2>3. CASE q[j].ops[i].key \notin MSSWritten(q[j].ops,i-1)
        <3>1. \/ /\ MSSVisibleWriters(q[j].ops[i].key,MSSReadTime(q[j].id)) = {}
                  /\ q[j].ops[i].value = NoValue
               \/ /\ q[j].ops[i].value \in MSSVisibleWriters(q[j].ops[i].key,MSSReadTime(q[j].id))
                  /\ \A u \in MSSVisibleWriters(q[j].ops[i].key,MSSReadTime(q[j].id)) :
                       MSSCommitTime(u) <= MSSCommitTime(q[j].ops[i].value)
            BY <1>F, <2>1, <2>3, MSSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF MSSReadMatches
        <3>2. SI!ExecutionStates(InitialState,q)[cut][q[j].ops[i].key] = q[j].ops[i].value
            BY <1>1, <2>1, <3>1, MSSVisiblePrefixValue, MSSProof!SMTT("r10")
        <3>3. QED BY <2>3, <3>2, MSSProof!SMTT("r10")
    <2>4. QED BY <2>2, <2>3, MSSProof!SMTT("r10")
<1>4. QED
    BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, MSSOwnComplete, MSSProof!SMTT("r10")

LEMMA MSSCertificateSound ==
    MSSHistoryType /\ MSSSnapshotCertificate => SnapshotIsolation
<1>0. SUFFICES ASSUME MSSHistoryType, MSSSnapshotCertificate PROVE SnapshotIsolation
    BY MSSProof!SMTT("r10")
<1>1. /\ MSSFinite!IsFiniteSet(SnapshotTransactions)
       /\ \A t \in SnapshotTransactions : MSSOrderRanks[t] \in Nat
    BY <1>0, MSSHistoryWellFormed, MSSFiniteBridge, MSSSnapshotMembers,
       MSSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF SI!WellFormed, MSSOrderRanks, MSSSnapshotCertificate
<1>2. PICK q \in SI!Orders(SnapshotTransactions) : MSSSorted(q,SnapshotTransactions,MSSOrderRanks)
    BY <1>1, MSSSortedOrderExists, MSSProof!SMTT("r10")
<1>3. MSSOrderFacts(q)
    BY <1>0, <1>2, MSSOrderedFacts, MSSProof!SMTT("r10")
<1>4. ASSUME NEW j \in 1..Len(q)
      PROVE \E cut \in 0..(j-1) : SI!SnapshotAt(SI!ExecutionStates(InitialState,q),q,j,cut)
    <2>1. PICK cut \in 0..(j-1) :
        \A i \in 1..Len(q) : (i <= cut) <=>
           (MSSCommitTime(q[i].id) <= MSSReadTime(q[j].id))
        BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, <1>4, MSSSortedCut, MSSSeq!ElementOfSeq,
           MSSProof!SMTT("r30") DEF MSSOrderFacts, MSSOrderRanks, MSSSorted
    <2>2. SI!Complete(SI!ExecutionStates(InitialState,q)[cut],q[j].ops)
              /\ SI!NoConf(q,j,cut)
        BY <1>0, <1>3, <1>4, <2>1, MSSCertificateComplete, MSSCertificateNoConflict,
           MSSProof!SMTT("r10")
    <2>3. QED BY <2>1, <2>2, MSSProof!SMTT("r10") DEF SI!SnapshotAt
<1>5. QED
    BY <1>0, <1>2, <1>4, MSSHistoryWellFormed, MSSProof!SMTT("r10")
    DEF SnapshotIsolation, SI!SnapshotIsolation, SI!ExecutionSatisfiesSI
